$comment: Which sprites of the bot's face (Spec/face.json) make each of the expressions the hands choose. The gestures and the expressions' names are cass's own (net.wirenook.cass, Spec/gestures.json): the same hand makes the same face on either avatar. An expression names an eyes sprite, a mouth sprite, or both; a layer it does not name keeps its neutral sprite, and `blush` adds the blush overlay. Sprites are named as in face.json, without the layer.
